issues.observation: MaterialLighting: final hero has a visibly bright short segment beneath the nozzle followed by a nearly invisible middle section before the stream reaches the cup. This persists in the denoised image.
issues.requested_change: For a future look-development run, establish continuous stream edge/reflection contrast from nozzle to impact at every approved view, without making the medium opaque. Do not render a fourth attempt in this bounded run.

issues.observation: MaterialLighting: darkening reduces the pale lower-fill wash but compresses cup-wall/free-surface information; side still carries dominant bright reflected patches.
issues.requested_change: For a future run, separate background/negative-fill control from broad illumination and confirm clear-volume readability alongside the stream. Preserve visible rim/base thickness and metal contact cues.

issues.observation: Render: raw final views retain conspicuous grain. OIDN substantially reduces it, while some fine transparent/free-surface detail is softened.
issues.requested_change: Keep raw and color-only denoised outputs distinctly labeled. A production pass needs a sampling/denoising choice checked against thin details and actual temporal playback.

summary: Final bounded look attempt: all three raw Cycles images and all three separately labeled HDR color-only OIDN versions were inspected. Geometry/thickness, shaped metal reflections, grounded support and reduced pale wash improved. However the hero stream loses visibility through a substantial middle section above the cup, so continuous pouring is not reliably readable. Darkening also suppresses some vessel/free-surface information; side remains dominated by bright reflected patches. This is a useful working CG prototype, not an accepted final beauty shot. Stop this run after three attempts; no fourth render is approved by this review. The review binds the raw three-view outputs, and qa/final_visual_review.json separately records denoised artifact hashes. No reference-photo match, GPU performance, browser appearance parity, fluid simulation, or final-film temporal quality is claimed.
